title: Synaptics Stock is Trending: SYNA Jumps 15% After Hours on Amended Merger Deal With ON Semiconductor - NewsBreak
text:
By Mohd Haider ,
58 minutes ago Photo: Jirapong Manustrong / Shutterstock - ejk Synaptics Inc. (NASDAQ: SYNA ) shares are trending on Thursday night.
Shares of the Californian semiconductor manufacturing company surged 15.03% to $122.10 in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company signed an amended merger agreement for an all-cash acquisition by ON Semiconductor Corp. (NASDAQ: ON ).
ON Semiconductor is an Arizona-based semiconductor supplier.
Rival Proposal Preceded the Amended Deal According to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission , Synaptics signed an Amended and Restated Merger Agreement with onsemi on Thursday. Each Synaptics share will convert into $123 in cash, without interest.
The amended deal replaces a June 25 agreement, with certain terms revised, the filing said. It followed an unsolicited, non-binding offer on Sept. 2 from an unnamed strategic bidder.

Synaptics’ board, working with a special committee of independent directors, first deemed that bidder’s revised proposal a “Superior Proposal.” After further negotiations with Onsemi, and on the committee’s recommendation, the board determined that, given the amended deal terms, the rival bid no longer qualified. It then unanimously approved the agreement, the filing said.
Closing requires a majority vote of Synaptics shareholders and approvals under antitrust and foreign investment laws. Hart-Scott-Rodino Act clearance, the U.S. antitrust review, is already secured. The deal also has no financing condition, according to the filing.
